# GrowthBook x Forus: Pilot Kickoff
Date: 2026-11-11 | Duration: 33m

## Summary
The team confirmed that a fully signed BAA completed the contracting phase and cleared the pilot path. Pilot planning covered success criteria, technical setup, testing duration, metrics, and analysis, with Scott responsible for circulating a living project plan. The team favored running two experiments, using experiment-specific tables without PHI to simplify setup and clarity. Fleming preferred self-hosted deployment, with Docker or Kubernetes options, while BigQuery access would begin with tightly scoped service-role permissions. Exposure data could be captured through a customer-managed callback or GrowthBook’s event forwarder, balancing control, implementation simplicity, destination-table behavior, and additional cost. The team planned to establish the self-hosted instance, license, service account, API host, BigQuery connection, and SDK integration during the first one to two weeks, launch experiments in week two, and request a six-week POC so each experiment could receive at least four weeks of data. Slack support and weekly or biweekly working sessions were available.

## Keywords
BigQuery, Self-hosting, Painted-door experiments, Experiment exposure events, Metrics catalogue, SDK integration
